title: PDT-Lean: a kernel-verified Lean 4 formalization of the Pisot Dimensional Theory core
description: A Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization that localizes, to a single named hypothesis, the assumptions of Pisot Dimensional Theory (PDT), and shows the listed consequences are elementary theorems (with that hypothesis kept explicit but not load-bearing in the quantum proofs). 256 declarations across 17 files (no sorry, no native_decide), with an included one-command Colab script that builds the project and self-certifies via #print axioms that each declaration depends only on Lean's standard axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound (250 checked directly; the 6 private helpers are covered transitively, since a result's axiom set includes those of everything it depends on). Verified content: the single-system quantum-mechanical kinematics (Born form |z|^2, dagger as complex conjugation, Hermitian as real, unitarity) as theorems about C (the named posit that a physical state space is this C is present but not used by the proofs); the trace-form signature certificates over Q pinning signatures (3,1) and (2,1) (the base-change to R and Sylvester's law of inertia is a standard prose step); the dagger identity relating the two canonical forms on the complex place (the Born form equals the trace form precomposed with complex conjugation, G_Born = G_trace o sigma) together with the alternating, nondegenerate symplectic form omega = Im(z-bar w) as the imaginary part of the Born rule -- the same complex structure J being a Born isometry (the unitary phase) and a trace anti-isometry (the Lorentzian time-rotation), the linear-algebra core of the Fault-Line-A / Proposition 1 result; the norm and discriminant arithmetic of x^3-x-1 and x^4-x-1 both as elementary integer identities and through the genuine Mathlib API (Algebra.norm, Algebra.discr, Algebra.traceForm over AdjoinRoot, and irreducibility over Q by reduction mod 2); the classical (<=2) and Tsirelson (2 sqrt 2, saturated) CHSH bounds; the Pisot-boundary dichotomy (every non-real root of x^3-x-1 has modulus < 1, every non-real root of x^4-x-1 has modulus > 1, by a Vieta reduction on the conjugate pair); the mechanical (Beatty) word of an abstract slope beta -- two-valued, of density exactly beta, balanced, and aperiodic for irrational beta carried as an explicit hypothesis; the anchored-stabilizer dimension identities at general N (surjectivity of X -> Xv on trace-zero matrices, stabilizer finrank N^2-N-1, the corank-1 trace character, and the orbit-stabilizer decomposition); and, at the two archimedean places of Q(rho), the exact contraction rate r*|z|^2 = 1 (equivalently |z| = r^(-1/2)) together with the integrality floor |sigma_1(x)|*|sigma_2(x)|^2 >= 1 for nonzero x in Z[rho] and its windowed separation and permanence consequences. The identification of that complex structure with the complex place of Q's field is the single step not evaluated in the kernel, by design; the theory's numerical physical predictions are out of scope for the kernel.
